title: Book 6 — Erato, Chapter 3
paragraphs: Then, when the Ionians asked Histiaeus for what reason he had so urgently charged Aristagoras to revolt from the king and brought so great an evil upon the Ionians, he did not at all declare to them what had truly been the cause; but he reported to them that King Darius had resolved to remove the Phoenicians from their land and settle them in Ionia, and the Ionians in Phoenicia, and that for this reason he had given the charge. Thus he tried to alarm the Ionians, although the king had never resolved to do anything of the kind.
